correctness.rationale: The source identifies the cut cross-matrix with duplicate columns and the simultaneous Boolean-layer operators (U_r,D_r). Over F2 these are wedge-by-u and contraction-by-f, with DU+UD=(n-2 mod 2)I. When n is even u lies in ker f, and splitting ker f=<u>+W yields intersection kernel u wedge Λ^(r-1)W of dimension C(n-4,k-2), including k=1,n-1 by the zero-binomial convention. For odd n the anticommutator is identity and the stack is injective. Graph-state character orthogonality yields 2^rank identical positive eigenvalues. Independently constructed actual Johnson edge cuts for n=4..10, all k (42 cases) agree in GF2 rank. Full arbitrary-n proof is algebraic, not numerical.
